name: Prepare the founder for a call
when: The founder has a call or meeting coming up with a named person and wants to walk in prepared.
procedure: Ask who the call is with, their company, the date, and what the founder wants out of it.
Use web_search for the person and company, with this year in the query, and web_fetch to read the 3 to 5 most useful pages.
Write who they are: role, company, what the company does, in three lines.
Write what they have said in public recently, each point with its date and link.
Write three questions the founder should ask, each tied to something they said.
Write one risk: the objection or conflict most likely to come up, and one line on how to meet it.
pitfalls: Old pages look current: put the date beside every fact and prefer this year's sources.
Two people can share a name: confirm the company before using a page.
No private data, and nothing that is not on a public page.
verify: The brief has who they are, at least three dated public statements each with a link, three questions tied to those statements, and one risk, and fits on one screen.
